1. Hardened method selection in [phase1_gui_tabs.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/phase1_gui_tabs.py#L493-L756) so mutation type parsing no longer depends on brittle enum-name conversion.

Fixed detection analysis source behavior by tracking the actual generated payload for analysis (`_analysis_payload`) in [phase1_gui_tabs.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/phase1_gui_tabs.py#L496-L756), so “Analyze Detection Risk” works consistently after any generation action.

5. Added engine-level input validation in [modules/malware_engine_integration.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/modules/malware_engine_integration.py#L55-L113): empty payload checks, iteration validation, string-to-enum method normalization, and safe percent calculations (no divide-by-zero).

## Validation Run

1. Ran `python -X utf8 test_phase1_integration.py` successfully: all 3 suites passed, including MalwareEngine tests.
2. Ran an offscreen UI smoke test invoking all mutation tab actions (`mutate_payload`, `generate_polymorphic`, `add_anti_analysis`, `generate_staged`, `analyze_detection`) with successful output/state updates.

content.text:
Updated the `Tools & Targets` tab to be fully functional and resilient across all tool modes.

## What I Fixed

1. Added tool-specific target normalization in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L8189-L8235), so host-based tools (`Port Scan`, `Banner Grab`, `Subdomain Enum`) correctly extract host/domain from pasted URLs, and web tools auto-add `https://` when missing.
2. Added strict tool-specific validation in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L8210-L8235), preventing invalid target formats from silently failing.
3. Improved `Learn from URL` flow in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L8243-L8259) with output clearing, error display, and proper learned exploit refresh.
4. Wired executor to use normalized targets in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L8266-L8270), so the tool runs with exactly what was validated.
5. Improved stop behavior in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L8272-L8278) to immediately reflect stop-request state in UI output.
6. Added robust error reporting in result handling in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L8283-L8291), so failures are visible instead of looking like empty results.
7. Improved findings table mapping for mixed result shapes (ports, banners, vuln dicts, path hits) in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L8296-L8325), so results render meaningfully instead of generic/blank cells.
8. Added clear completion messaging for partial stopped runs vs complete runs in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L8330-L8335).

## Validation

1. `python -X utf8 -m py_compile HadesAI.py` passed.
2. Ran direct method checks for normalization/validation across all tool types; all returned expected normalized targets with no validation errors for valid inputs.

If you want, I can also add a quick “Tool Profiles” selector next (fast/normal/deep) so scans run at different intensities from the same tab.

1. defense level now applies live when enabled;
2. auto-response now toggles defense rules on/off;

4. Added runtime event hooks so engine actions/mitigations update tab logs and blocked IP state in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L4668-L4835).
5. Improved status/log synchronization on enable/disable and manual actions in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L4708-L4835).

## Verification

4. controls are present and functional.

If you want, next I can add a small stats panel in this tab (threats mitigated, blocked IP count, active honeypots) so you can see defense effectiveness at a glance.

Added a live **Defense Stats** panel to the Active Defense tab.

## What’s Added

1. New stats section in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L4654-L4685) with cards for:
1. `Mitigated`
2. `IPs Blocked`
3. `Honeypot Hits`
4. `Active Honeypots`
5. `Tracked IPs`
2. New stats refresh method in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L4721-L4743): `_update_active_defense_stats()`.
3. Wired stats refresh into all key events in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L4768-L4855):
1. enable/disable
2. block/unblock
3. defense level change
4. auto-response toggle
5. threshold change
6. action/mitigation callbacks
4. Improved blocked IP metric calculation in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L4730-L4739) to reflect both engine counters and rate-limiter blocked set.
5. Incremented `ips_blocked` stat on manual block in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L4790-L4795) so manual actions are counted in the panel.

## Validation

1. `python -X utf8 -m py_compile HadesAI.py` passed.
2. Offscreen GUI smoke test confirmed stats panel renders and updates with Active Defense actions.

Payload Gen tab is now fully functional and resilient, including edge cases.

## What I Fixed

1. Fixed unknown-type dead-end behavior in [payload_generator_gui.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/payload_generator_gui.py#L564-L633): when detection returns `unknown` with zero payloads, the tab now automatically falls back to the selected override type and generates payloads.
2. Kept UI state consistent after fallback in [payload_generator_gui.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/payload_generator_gui.py#L564-L633):
1. type label shows override source (`unknown → <type> (override)`);
2. payload count reflects actual displayed payloads;
3. override combo stays synced to effective type.
3. Fixed integration profile consistency in [payload_generator_gui.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/payload_generator_gui.py#L582-L633) so saved profile uses effective type/payloads/count (not stale `unknown` result fields).
4. Improved completion logging in [payload_generator_gui.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/payload_generator_gui.py#L633-L636) to report actual generated payload count and effective type.

## Validation

1. `python -X utf8 -m py_compile payload_generator_gui.py` passed.
2. Runtime smoke test confirmed:
1. normal generation works;
2. unknown file + override now produces payloads instead of empty table;
3. copy-all still works with generated payloads.

If you want, next I can add a small status badge (`Detected` vs `Override`) in the tab header for even clearer operator feedback.

Implemented a full upgrade to Exploit Tome detail depth and exploit-folder processing.

## What I Changed

1. Reworked folder importer in [import_exploits_from_folder.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/import_exploits_from_folder.py) to recursively process nested folders and derive categories from relative paths instead of only shallow category directories.
2. Expanded supported import file types in [import_exploits_from_folder.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/import_exploits_from_folder.py) via `TEXT_EXTENSIONS` so exploit scripts/configs are no longer skipped as aggressively.
3. Added richer metadata extraction in [import_exploits_from_folder.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/import_exploits_from_folder.py):
1. platform/target inference from content and filename/path;
2. CVE extraction with regex;
3. reference link extraction (URLs + source file URI);
4. smarter tags (category, target, extension, keyword hints, CVE flag);
5. detailed notes (source path, size, lines, inferred target, CVEs).
4. Improved import logging output in [import_exploits_from_folder.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/import_exploits_from_folder.py) to show richer status per exploit (`tags`, `cves`) for easier audit.
5. Added Exploit Folder import button to GUI in [exploit_tome_gui.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/exploit_tome_gui.py) with end-to-end wired action (`_import_exploit_folder`) using the upgraded importer.
6. Made details panel more informative in [exploit_tome_gui.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/exploit_tome_gui.py) by showing reference count and listing reference links for selected exploit.
7. Fixed save-path schema bug in [exploit_tome_gui.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/exploit_tome_gui.py): `_save_exploit` now correctly uses `reference_links` instead of invalid `references`.
8. Improved exploit ID generation in [exploit_tome_gui.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/exploit_tome_gui.py) to UUID-based suffixes to avoid timestamp collision issues.

## Validation

1. `python -X utf8 -m py_compile import_exploits_from_folder.py exploit_tome_gui.py exploit_tome.py` passed.
2. Ran a functional import test using a temp exploit folder with nested categories and CVE/URL content:
1. imports succeeded;
2. categories/targets/tags/CVEs/references were populated as expected;
3. Exploit Tome database entries reflected enhanced metadata.

Both tabs are now fully functional and I verified them with focused runtime checks.

## AI Orchestration Tab

1. Added explicit backend-error escalation in [phase1_gui_tabs.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/phase1_gui_tabs.py#L178-L251) for:
1. `execute_attack`
2. `deploy_defense`
3. `generate_payload`
4. `plan_movement`
2. This prevents silent “success-looking” UI output when integration returns `{'status': 'error'}`.

## Ethical Control Tab

1. Added authorization level control in [phase1_gui_tabs.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/phase1_gui_tabs.py#L257-L487):
1. new `Authorization Level` dropdown (bound to `AuthorizationLevel`)
2. `set_authorization_level()` handler
3. status-sync so dropdown reflects backend state on refresh
2. Added whitelist removal features in [phase1_gui_tabs.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/phase1_gui_tabs.py#L313-L487):
1. `Remove Selected Target`
2. `Remove Selected Exploit`
3. handlers: `remove_selected_target()` and `remove_selected_exploit()`

## Validation

1. `python -X utf8 -m py_compile phase1_gui_tabs.py` passed.
2. Offscreen GUI smoke test confirmed:
1. all Obsidian actions execute and append results;
2. Ethical add/remove target and exploit actions work;
3. Ethical authorization level changes to `EXECUTE` and syncs in UI.
3. Phase 1 integration tests remain passing (`test_phase1_integration.py`).

The two tabs are functionally complete with working controls, backend wiring, and improved failure handling.
